name: Singi-Kaitumjaure

difficulty.label: Easy mountain stage; no formal grade beyond official descriptive wording
difficulty.source: STF calls this an easy stage and Naturkartan describes easy walking with small elevation changes. Field reports agree that the walking is generally straightforward, but weather, boardwalk condition, mosquitoes and the final birch/boardwalk approach can make it feel harder.
caveats: STF lists 4-5 hours; Naturkartan Swedish/API evidence lists 4-6 hours and English text was reported as 5-6 hours in the geometry lane.
Difficulty can increase with cold wind, rain, early-season snow patches, worn boardwalks and mosquitoes around lower/birch areas.

notes: Official direction is Singi to Kaitumjaure.
This is the candidate mainline continuation after Salka-Singi and STF Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta stage 3.
Singi is also the junction where the Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta access route leaves or joins the Kungsleden mainline; keep that as connector/access metadata.
Kaitumjaure is a remote hut endpoint before the next mainline stage toward Teusajaure.

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta
relevance: Official STF route-group ordering.
Lists stage 3 as STF Singi Mountain cabin-STF Kaitumjaure Mountain cabin, 13 km, 4-5 hours.

Describes the route following Tjaktjajakka toward Lake Kaitumjaure, with reindeer-herding context, good water/rest opportunities for the first 10 km, a bridge about 3 km north of Kaitumjaure and boardwalked terrain before the hut.
Mentions Kaitumjaure shop context.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan: Singi - Kaitumjaure, Kungsleden
relevance: Official county/Naturkartan route page.
Lists 13.0 km and 4-6 hours in Swedish/API evidence; English duration was reported as 5-6 hours.
Describes Tjaktjavagge, Tjaktjajakka, Stuor Avrrik, Stuor Jierta, the suspension bridge, mountain birch descent and Padje Kaitumjaure/Bajip Gaidumjavri views.
States good tent sites and plenty of water along the section.
Page/source evidence points to Naturkartan site id 12881.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan API site 12881
relevance: Official linework candidate.
API geometry is a single-line MultiLineString with 623 points, official direction Singi-to-Kaitumjaure.
API length field is 13.0 km; computed line length in the geometry lane was about 12.405 km; updated 2026-04-27T13:11:29.
API reports publish_gpx=false even though a public GPX URL worked on the access date.

officialSources.name: STF Singi Mountain Cabin
relevance: Start hut GPS, services, no-shop context and 2026 staffed periods.
Singi has 3 guest cabins, 44 beds, self-catering kitchen, limited pet rooms, no mobile coverage and host phone/call time.
STF describes Singi as about 14 km west of Kebnekaise, about 33 km from road at Nikkaluokta and about 13 km north of Kaitumjaure.

officialSources.name: STF Kaitumjaure Mountain Cabin
relevance: End hut GPS, services, shop/sauna context and 2026 staffed periods.
Kaitumjaure has 2 guest cabins, 30 beds, sauna, small shop, self-catering kitchen, limited pet rooms, one dog-allowed guest cabin, no mobile coverage and host phone/call time.
STF describes Kaitumjaure as 13 km south of Singi and 9 km north of Teusajaure.

rules: Dogs: treat as leash-required in Norrbotten reindeer-herding area where reindeer are present and herding is allowed. Extra control applies 1 March-20 August.
Reindeer: keep distance, do not walk toward animals, detour around grazing reindeer and stop/let herds pass.
Fishing: STF suggests buying fishing permits in advance. Permit issuer and water-specific rules need confirmation, including whether waters are under Girjas/NatureIT or Lansstyrelsen administration.
Hunting: 2025/2026 small-game season ended 2026-03-15 in the checked Lansstyrelsen material; 2026/2027 rules were not found and need recheck for late-August/September use.

Drones: Transportstyrelsen drone rules apply. Protected-area permissions may be needed if launching/landing in national parks or nature reserves; even outside protected areas avoid disturbing reindeer and nesting birds.
safetyNotes: Weather/exposure is a major practical hazard despite easy terrain; field reports mention cold wind, rain and fresh/small snow patches.
Tjaktjajakka bridge is a known route feature. Field reports call it wobbly but no closure/impassable report was found.
Boardwalks on the southern approach can be worn, loose, mossy or swampy depending on conditions and maintenance.
Mosquitoes can be severe around Kaitumjaure, birch forest and lower/lake areas in summer.
Mobile coverage is absent at both STF Singi and STF Kaitumjaure according to STF hut context.
currentness: No section-specific closure, reroute or bridge-out notice was found on Lansstyrelsen Aktuellt i fjallen as of 2026-04-29.
Lansstyrelsen 2026-04-22 and 2026-03-27 notices warn about deteriorated winter-route snow/ice and stopped route checks; these are spring travel safety warnings, not summer closures.
STF Singi staffed/open periods: 2026-02-20 to 2026-04-19 and 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-13.
STF Kaitumjaure staffed/open periods: 2026-02-27 to 2026-04-19 and 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-13.
On 2026-04-29 both huts were between staffed seasons; expect only emergency/safety space rather than staffed service.
Recheck official current pages, bridge/boardwalk status, fire bans, hunting/reindeer restrictions, hut service and access timetables immediately before public/runtime use.
